# XY Forever serial protocol 1.19

XY Forever is a boot menu and firmware manager for the teenage engineering OP-XY. While its menu runs, the OP-XY's processor B answers this protocol over USB.
Tools use it to list, read, write and delete files, take screenshots, stage and install builds, set the default firmware and restart the device.

Transport: USB CDC serial, the raw frame stream (table below). The device answers only while the XY Forever menu runs: after an XY Forever restart, or when the
OP-XY is powered on with PLAY held (release it at the logo).

All numbers are little-endian. Byte counts are in decimal unless written in hex (`0x...`).

The machine-readable specification is [`protocol/v1.json`](../protocol/v1.json); these pages, the firmware header, the host module and the TypeScript module
(`clients/ts/src/v1.ts`) are generated from it. Version 1.19 describes the device as it is today. "Since" names the version that introduced an entry's current
form.
